edition: Unofficial Zork Mara House Company Glulx

overrides.description: Extend Mara state and grammar for House company
Preserve Release 1243 history while adding House-specific memory
Add invitation, physical camp retrieval, and shared meal actions
Let Mara act on her own pack and respond to earned House history

player_outcomes: after the joint Dam survey, Mara can physically accompany the adventurer through the old passages to the canonical barred Cellar threshold
UNBAR TRAP DOOR WITH MARA uses Mara's own measured rope plus the adventurer's lift to draw the real upper bar and set the real trap door open; solo Zork remains unchanged
natural TRAP DOOR, DOOR, HATCH, and THRESHOLD language in the Cellar resolves to the existing observational threshold instead of a duplicate door object
after physically crossing the reopened stair, Mara can judge the white House from direct experience
INVITE MARA does not teleport her camp or convert the House into an automatic residence
the first invitation creates a concrete return trip to the Dam Base, where MARA, TAKE PACK makes Mara retrieve her own physical field pack
the pack then travels inside Mara's actual custody along the authored route back to the House
Mara accepts the House only from the Attic after inspecting the place and sets her own pack there by explicit consent
SHARE LUNCH WITH MARA consumes the one real prepared lunch once, feeds both characters in fiction, and leaves the player a smaller stamina reserve than eating the entire meal alone
House and company dialogue changes because these events happened, without exposing an approval score or converting friendship into romance
Release 1243 save history is preserved when the Mara state schema advances
boundaries: the canonical barred trap door remains canonical for solo play; only the earned, physical Mara-assisted action creates the authored two-person exception
no duplicate trap door, generic housing system, follower framework, party inventory, approval meter, dating simulator, or romance reward
no teleporting Mara, her camp, her equipment, the lunch, or relationship history
no duplicated food, survey sheets, field equipment, routes, or door objects
no replacement of canonical Dam, troll, House, Kitchen, cuisine, museum, or fishing mechanics
no new audit framework, validator-of-validator machinery, debug actors, TODOs, stubs, or no-op architecture
